title: AI-Semiconductor Initiative
summary: Plan for AI and AI chips presented at a meeting chaired by President Yoon Suk Yeol on 9 April 2024. It pledged KRW 9.4 trillion of public investment in AI and related semiconductors by 2027 and a KRW 1.4 trillion fund for AI chip firms. It expands R&D on neural processing units and next-generation high-bandwidth memory, supports general-purpose AI and AI safety work, and sets a goal of more than 10% of the global system-semiconductor market by 2030. It also proposed a presidential committee to coordinate public-private cooperation on AI chips. It was adopted under the previous administration.

sources.title: President pledges KRW 9.4T investment in AI, chips by 2027
